nativeVerification.ios: Actual small and medium Home Screen widgets on iPhone 16 Pro Max / iOS 18.3. Previous cap-height approximation put the numeral 3 pixels above and below the sentence anchors; the subsequent guessed -1-point denominator offset put its 1 digit 3 pixels below line three. Both are superseded. The final implementation sizes from Core Text glyph outlines and independently aligns the lower edge of each denominator glyph, rounding measured corrections to device pixels. Untouched light/dark screenshots at live score 3 measure numeral and first capital tops at row 423; numeral, slash, 1, 0 and the flat-bottom line-three letter all end at row 572 using the 50% normalized-contrast contour. A second live reading (7:06 PM) was verified with new sentence anchors and the same zero pixel differences. Both widgets showed matching new timestamps after the updated app opened. These measurements prove the captured states, not every score or accessibility configuration.
